answer: At dawn each epoch, assign every identity a different wharf chosen secretly at the last minute, and require a live report, within minutes, of local conditions there as the sun climbs toward its zenith: tide height, a harbour nonce displayed on site, and a short sensor trace. One operator cannot be at many wharves at once, and clones fed the same trace correlate perfectly despite claiming different locations, exposing the farm. An honest agent attends only its own berth; a sybil must deploy a real observer for every identity, so scale costs rise per fake instead of being copied free.
